evidence.quote: Metro is the transportation agency for the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area
Smart Trip is how to pay for Metro Rail, Metro Bus, Metro parking garages and lots
Buy a new plastic card online and receive it by mail.
Travel includes your everyday travel purchases, like parking, public transit
Merchants in this category include operators of passenger trains, buses, taxis, limousines, rideshare, ferries, toll bridges and highways, and parking lots and garages.
Select transit includes car rentals, ferries, commuter railways, subways, taxis/limousines/car services
Long-range passenger landrail and bus charters are also included.

draft.notes: The site is primarily a transit agency, but it explicitly sells and mails physical Smart Trip cards.
